applicability.excerpt: .description("This is a simple 1D model demonstrating ultrafast heat transfer simulations for femtosecond pulsed laser heating.

Specifically, the following three models are implemented and compared with conventional Fourier heat conduction (known as parabolic one-step, POS): hyperbolic one-step (HOS), parabolic two-step (PTS), and hyperbolic two-step (HTS).");
